SELECT repository_fts.rowid AS github_repository_id, bm25(repository_fts, 0.25, 0.25, 3.0, 3.0, 1.0, 0.25, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0) AS score, highlight(repository_fts, 0, char(1), char(2)) AS h0, highlight(repository_fts, 1, char(1), char(2)) AS h1, highlight(repository_fts, 2, char(1), char(2)) AS h2, highlight(repository_fts, 3, char(1), char(2)) AS h3, highlight(repository_fts, 4, char(1), char(2)) AS h4, highlight(repository_fts, 5, char(1), char(2)) AS h5, highlight(repository_fts, 6, char(1), char(2)) AS h6, highlight(repository_fts, 7, char(1), char(2)) AS h7, highlight(repository_fts, 8, char(1), char(2)) AS h8 FROM repository_fts WHERE repository_fts MATCH '"modal" OR "editor" OR "terminal" OR "editors" OR "ides"' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM repository_classifications AS rc JOIN taxonomy_route_registry AS tr ON tr.match_category_id = rc.category_id WHERE rc.github_repository_id = repository_fts.rowid AND tr.route_id = 'editors_ides') ORDER BY score ASC, github_repository_id ASC LIMIT 150
